title: Two Circles
statementMd:
Let's assume that we are given an $*n* × *m*$ table filled by integers. We'll mark a cell in the $*i*$-th row and $*j*$-th column as $(*i*, *j*)$. Thus, $(1, 1)$ is the upper left cell of the table and $(*n*, *m*)$ is the lower right cell. We'll assume that a circle of radius $*r*$ with the center in cell $(*i*_{0}, *j*_{0})$ is a set of such cells $(*i*, *j*)$ that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc31a09fb096da664822c5fcf9cd3970b9c13e20.png). We'll consider only the circles that do not go beyond the limits of the table, that is, for which $*r* + 1 ≤ *i*_{0} ≤ *n* - *r*$ and $*r* + 1 ≤ *j*_{0} ≤ *m* - *r*$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a55d6e0ba8c3d7efb39f3b8d5a099f09f08fba2.png) A circle of radius 3 with the center at $(4, 5)$.

Find two such non-intersecting circles of the given radius $*r*$ that the sum of numbers in the cells that belong to these circles is maximum. Two circles intersect if there is a cell that belongs to both circles. As there can be more than one way to choose a pair of circles with the maximum sum, we will also be interested in the number of such pairs. Calculate the number of unordered pairs of circles, for instance, a pair of circles of radius 2 with centers at $(3, 4)$ and $(7, 7)$ is the same pair as the pair of circles of radius 2 with centers at $(7, 7)$ and $(3, 4)$.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*$, $*m*$ and $*r*$ ($2 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$, $*r* ≥ 0$). Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains $*m*$ integers from 1 to 1000 each — the elements of the table. The rows of the table are listed from top to bottom at the elements in the rows are listed from left to right. It is guaranteed that there is at least one circle of radius $*r*$, not going beyond the table limits.

## Output

Print two integers — the maximum sum of numbers in the cells that are located into two non-intersecting circles and the number of pairs of non-intersecting circles with the maximum sum. If there isn't a single pair of non-intersecting circles, print `0 0`.
statementZhMd:
假设我们有一个填满整数的 $*n* × *m*$ 表格。我们将第 $*i*$ 行第 $*j*$ 列的单元格标记为 $(*i*, *j*)$。因此，$(1, 1)$ 是表格的左上角单元格，而 $(*n*, *m*)$ 是表格的右下角单元格。我们定义，圆心位于单元格 $(*i*_{0}, *j*_{0})$、半径为 $*r*$ 的圆，是满足以下条件的所有单元格 $(*i*, *j*)$ 的集合：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cc31a09fb096da664822c5fcf9cd3970b9c13e20.png)。我们只考虑完全位于表格范围内的圆，即满足 $*r* + 1 ≤ *i*_{0} ≤ *n* - *r*$ 且 $*r* + 1 ≤ *j*_{0} ≤ *m* - *r*$ 的圆。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4a55d6e0ba8c3d7efb39f3b8d5a099f09f08fba2.png) 圆心位于 $(4, 5)$、半径为 3 的圆。

请找出两个互不相交的、半径为 $*r*$ 的圆，使得属于这两个圆的单元格中的数字之和最大。如果存在某个单元格同时属于两个圆，则称这两个圆相交。由于可能有多种选择圆对的方式能够得到最大和，我们还需要求出这样的圆对数量。我们计算无序圆对，例如，半径为 2、圆心分别位于 $(3, 4)$ 和 $(7, 7)$ 的一对圆，与圆心分别位于 $(7, 7)$ 和 $(3, 4)$ 的一对圆是同一对。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ 和 $*r*$（$2 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 500$，$*r* ≥ 0$）。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数，每个整数均在 1 到 1000 之间，表示表格中的元素。表格的行按照从上到下的顺序给出，每行中的元素按照从左到右的顺序给出。保证至少存在一个半径为 $*r*$ 且未超出表格范围的圆。

## 输出格式

输出两个整数——位于两个互不相交的圆中的单元格内数字之和的最大值，以及具有最大和的互不相交圆对的数量。如果不存在一对互不相交的圆，则输出 `0 0`。
